body: macOS M5 to M14 (probe at d36b748 + PROBE_AX switch, in-app input, guard armed):U+000AU+000AU+002D M5 draft safety: pass. Typed two lines, `kill -9` 1.2 s later, relaunch: "Draft restored" with the exact text; the banner's Discard empties it; reopening shows an empty composer with no banner (m5_draft_after_kill.png, m5_reopen_clean.png).U+000AU+002D M6 voice: pass. Record, save gives a VOICE card 0:12; Play runs to 0:12 and returns to Play; no errors. Audibility not checked. No mic prompt appeared because the probe was launched from Warp, which already had microphone access (TCC attributes to the responsible process).U+000AU+002D M7 video: pass with one cosmetic. Launching the probe from the shell made macOS ask "Warp would like to access the Camera"; the owner declined it; m.zsh now launches the probe with `open -n` (parent launchd) so prompts name field_notes_probe, and the owner allowed camera for field_notes_probe. Live preview shows before recording (Android H8 has no macOS counterpart). Stop saves the clip; playback shows picture (m7_playing.png, 0:02 of 0:08) and ends. Close during recording discards silently; open-then-Close saves nothing. Cosmetic: the recording timer pill "0:00" overlaps the "Camera" label at the top of the recorder (m7_recorder_open.png); card header says 0:09 while the player says 0:08. A 0:04 video at 00:53 was created during the owner's permission hand step.U+000AU+002D M8 mood: pass. Calm, then change asks "Change today's bloom?" and Grateful persists across a relaunch.U+000AU+002D M9 calendar: pass. Month back/forward, today's cell goes to Today, Sep 20 day detail with "Add a note" saves "Saved to September 20", edit from its viewer saves, Escape backs out; cells read "Day 20, has entries".U+000AU+002D M10 search: pass. Result previews the matching line; no-match state "No days match". Cosmetic: when a result opens, the day sheet auto-scrolls and the hover Edit/Delete pill of the card under the stationary pointer stays drawn above the sheet at y=-16 over the title bar, hit-testable (log-actions-edit), until the real mouse moves; any native mouse move clears it (m10_floating_pill_crop.png). The search clear button has no label.U+000AU+002D M11 garden: pass. 1 Grateful bloom and 1 sprout (Sep 20, no mood); streak 1 day, longest 1 (non-consecutive days). Cosmetic "1 Sprouts".U+000AU+002D M12 settings (probe part): pass for text size (applies app-wide), week start Monday (calendar and this-week garden), sound toggle synced between sidebar and Settings. Spell check and reminder are left to the plain build (probe stubs them). The Text size slider has an empty accessibility label.U+000AU+002D M13 export: a native Save sheet opens (AX: sheet 1 with "Save As: field-notes-export-20260927-010438", local time; Cancel, Save); Cancel closes it and re-enables Export. The probe's `shot` cannot capture native sheets, so the evidence is the AX read. Delete all deferred until after the accessibility sweep.U+000AU+002D M14 long note (c20000-p8, scenario "long"): pass. Scroll 91 frames, 1 over the 8.3 ms budget at 120 Hz, raster p95 4.4 ms; typing 51 chars 0 frames over budget, key handler p95 5.06 ms (GP1 target 4 ms, not user-visible).U+000AU+002D The guard aborted twice more on owner keypresses (01:02:28, 01:03:07); the owner confirmed they were typing.
